method: Local V2 fixed-input counterfactual removes immediate preceding same-direction swap only. Official factory and actual integer output reproduced for front and target. Require exact consecutive reserve state and no intervening pool event. Hold target input fixed, so not full multihop/whole-block reexecution, not equilibrium or trader net profit. No sum with cashflow or execution-shortfall totals.
